decisions.reason: As a mobile slow-speed shredder close to the firm's existing equipment, it leverages related knowledge and the firm can use its own R&D and research cooperation to interpret early results and improve the product, though the newer E line may absorb some focus.
As the flagship modular plant concept central to the firm's strategic direction and building on established capabilities, its strong fit with existing knowledge makes withdrawal very unlikely.
A trommel screen close to the firm's established offer allows the firm to recognize and assimilate market feedback using existing knowledge and R&D, supporting continued retention.
The slow-speed shredder line builds directly on the firm's existing slow-speed shredder knowledge and benefits from internal R&D and cooperation, making it well understood and likely to stay.
Spiral shaft screens build on the firm's established offer, and with internal R&D and research cooperation the firm can learn from early results and improve the line, making a drop unlikely.
